newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH NORDIC ALUMINIUM SAYS MAY SEEK LISTING.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH NORDIC ALUMINIUM SAYS MAY SEEK LISTING.

text.p: Finnish aluminium profile maker Nordic Aluminium Oy said on Wednesday it may seek a listing on the Helsinki Stock Exchange to support growth and raise its profile.

"Nordic Alumium, the leading Finnish aluminium profile maker and the company's shareholders ... are considering possibility to list Nordic Alumium shares on the Helsinki Stock Exchange," Nordic Alumium said in a statement.
Nordic Alumium, previously Nokia Alumiini, is owned by funds administrated by Morgan Stanley Capital Partners and CapMan Capital Management, the company said.
Nordic Alumium said a possible listing would take place in 1997. Enskilda Securities had been named adviser for the possible offering, it said.
Nokia Alumium said its 1996 operating profit before depreciation was 40.7 million markka, up from 39.3 million markka in 1995. Net sales fell to 314.1 million markka from 349.5 million.
Return on investment was 16.3 percent in 1996, up from 14.9 percent and the equity to assets ratio rose to 34.3 percent from 24.5 percent.
